name: Local Adjacency Matrix Independence
description: Replaces the parity-based assignment rules with an algebraic condition: the 3x3 local interaction matrix of the three steps must be linearly independent over the reals. Models must deduce that this symmetric zero-diagonal matrix has a non-zero determinant if and only if all its off-diagonal entries are 1 (i.e. a triangle), forcing algebraic reasoning to uncover the graph structure before applying an optimized algorithm.
